title: Every animation file tracked with its preview and its source
summary: Every animation file the installation has been given is tracked in a new folder collection/ as its ODRG or ODRGX file, never its JSON, with a copy of its preview GIF and a readme of its source beside it, written with a new --beside option of the converter's thumbnail subcommand and kept in shape by a new test; the decision that every animation's JSON source is committed gives way for these files, and the spec is written for Git LFS until the owner chooses between it and plain git.
